# Development docs hygiene Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Stop wrong development pages looking current in the Developers nav; keep publishing new notes; require agents to update docs with the change.

**Architecture:** `git mv` clearly wrong pages into `development/archive/`; replace the flat `development` autogenerated dump with curated Guides + Archive; add **Docs with the change** to `AGENTS.md`. Archive criterion is wrong/misleading — not “shipped.”

**Tech Stack:** Docusaurus sidebars, Markdown under `web_docs/docs/`, `AGENTS.md`.

**Spec / issue:** [development-docs-hygiene-design](./development-docs-hygiene-design.md) · [#721](https://github.com/getcommunityone/open-navigator/issues/721)

## Global Constraints

- Archive = wrong or misleading only; do not mass-archive shipped plans.
- Keep publishing new `*-design.md` / `*-plan.md`.
- Docs under `web_docs/docs/`; kebab-case; frontmatter on new pages.
- Branch `docs/721-development-docs-hygiene`; Conventional Commits; `Closes #721`.
- Repo process: PR → green CI → squash-merge (no finish-menu detour).

## Wave 1 archive set (wrong-path / superseded snapshots)

`git mv` these into `web_docs/docs/development/archive/`:

- `docs-migration.md`, `readme-migration.md`
- `react-refactoring.md`, `dashboard-redesign.md`
- `integration-status.md`, `openstates-integration.md`
- `homepage-redesign.md`, `homepage-redesign-summary.md`, `homepage-quick-start.md`
- `database-driven-homepage.md`, `quickstart-database-causes.md`
- `trending-causes-implementation.md`, `real-time-statistics.md`
- `schema-migration-summary.md`, `search-update-summary.md`, `county-data-status.md`
- `changelog.md`, `enhancements.md`, `new-capabilities.md`, `refactoring-summary.md`
- `intel-arc-quickstart.md`, `intel-optimization.md`
- `migration-v2.md` (legacy v2 product narrative in handbook Explanation)

Do **not** move living guides (`cleanup-roadmap`, `code-walkthrough`, `dataops-walkthrough`, Jev/AI hubs, accurate designs/plans).
